summary: Round-3 engineering-visual retest of construction.html sections 05-12 (frontend only, no backend). Verified the five previous findings plus global regression at 1600x1000, 1440x900, 1366x768, 1280x800, 1024x768, 834x1112, 390x844. Findings 1 (06 sequence drawing variants + strip alignment + cumulative fill), 4 (05 cage initial render + strict mark order), 5 (10 MEP tabs/labels/geometry) and the 07 continuity trace / pinned-reading regression all PASS. Findings 2 (12 convergence diagram) and 3 (08 figure typography) are FIXED at 390x844 and 834x1112 but REGRESS in the 900-1200px band (tested 1024x768 and 1180x900), where the mobile SVG variants are still active: the 12 diagram text lands on top of the closing copy and the 08/06 annotations render 2-3x larger than body copy with two text overlaps reappearing. Copy gate cx_verify_0512.py passes (227 lines, CONTENT INTEGRITY OK). Zero console/page errors and zero horizontal overflow at every tested width.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1024x768 and 1180x900 the mobile variant is still used (media query max-width:1200px) but the 80%-wide 440x252 SVG renders 469-541px tall, so 'COMPLETED BUILDING', 'CONCEPTUAL SYNTHESIS' and 'NO PERFORMANCE VALUES IMPLIED' are drawn directly over the H1 and the first two body paragraphs. Measured 1024x768: svg bottom 583 vs copy top 414 -> 3 text-on-text clashes; 1180x900: svg bottom 655 vs copy top 519 -> 4 clashes. Correct at 390x844 (bot 268 vs 313) and 834x1112 (bot 471 vs 726).

SVG font-size is declared in viewBox user units (.cx-det-fig .cx-dwg text {font-size:18px} inside the max-width:1200px query). Rendered size therefore grows with container width: 11px at 390, 24px at 834, 28px at 1024, 30px at 1180 (body copy is 13-15px). Rotated layer labels occupy 163-189px tall boxes, annotations dominate the linework and two overlaps reappear at 1180x900: AIR/VAPOUR* (3x57px real overlap) and 'CRITICAL JUNCTIONS - CONTINUITY...' vs 'THERMAL CONTINUITY' (365x3px). At 834 the same two pairs are tangent (2px). 'ASSEMBLY - PROJECT SPECIFIC' reaches x=1136 of 1180 (very tight to the edge).

ui_bugs.component: Section 06 .cx-insp-elem--m (mobile sequence drawing) in the 900-1200px band
ui_bugs.issue: Same viewBox-unit font problem (.cx-dwg text 13px on a 540-unit viewBox): cell labels render 26px at 1024 and 30px at 1180 (9px on the desktop variant), the header line is 862-993px wide, and the labels sit far below their cells so the annotation-to-cell association is lost while the linework is barely visible. No overlap, but visually the drawing is type-dominated between 900 and 1200px.

issues: SVG drawing annotations are larger than the surrounding body copy in sections 06, 08 and 12 because drawing type is sized in viewBox units with no cap on the rendered scale

Suggested fix: cap the rendered scale (svg max-width / max-height so scale <= 1) or add a dedicated 900-1200px band with proportionally smaller viewBox font sizes, and lower the .cx-final-dwg / .cx-insp-elem variant breakpoint from 1200px to ~900px

action_items: Section 12: prevent the mobile convergence diagram from overlapping the closing copy between ~960px and 1200px (lower the variant breakpoint to ~900px, or constrain the svg with max-height/max-width and reserve vertical space above the copy).

Sections 06/08 (and generally .cx-dwg): cap the rendered annotation size so drawing type stays <= body copy size in the 834-1200px band; this also removes the AIR/VAPOUR* and CRITICAL JUNCTIONS/THERMAL CONTINUITY overlaps that reappear at 1180x900 and are tangent at 834x1112.
Re-run the 1024x768 / 1180x900 checks after the fix - the previous round only measured 390, 834 and 1600, which is why this band was missed.
critical_code_review_comments: construction.css: SVG text sizes are set in viewBox user units inside the max-width:1200px media query (.cx-dwg text 13px, .cx-det-fig 18px, .cx-mep-viz 16px, .cx-final-dwg 11px). Because preserveAspectRatio scales the viewBox to the container, the rendered px size is width-dependent (1.4-1.7x at 1024-1180). Either drive these sizes from the viewBox-to-pixel scale or cap the svg width.

The 1200px breakpoint is used for both the drawing variant switch and the mobile font bump; the two concerns need separate breakpoints because the layout has room for the desktop drawing well below 1200px.
alignBar() in construction.js correctly pads .cx-insp-bar to the letterboxed drawing width (measured deltas 0..-10px at 1440/1600) - it only runs for the desktop variant, which is the right scope.

success_rate.frontend: ~78% (5 of 7 checked areas fully pass; 2 pass on phone/tablet but regress in the 960-1200px band)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS this round (no need to re-derive): (1) 06 drawing - .cx-insp-elem--m visible at 390/834 (label heights 11px/21px, 0 overlaps), .cx-insp-elem--d at 1440/1600 with cell-left vs state-label-left deltas 0,-3,-5,-8,-10,+2px; cumulative cell fill stays in lockstep with the active column and all six C.01..C.06 states are reachable forwards and in reverse. (4) 05 cage - model already drawn at progress 0 (mark 1 on, disclaimer visible), marks activate strictly one at a time forwards and reverse at 1440/1600. (5) 10 MEP - 7 tabs, each activates exactly one cx-mep-layer, cx-mep-caption updates correctly, 0 SVG text overlaps at 390/834/1440/1600; geometry reviewed statically: risers sit at x=324..356 inside the shaft gap (316-364) where slab lines are interrupted, and branch runs at y=100..418 avoid the slab lines at y=156/272/388, so no service line crosses a slab outside the marked engineered openings. 07 (.cx-wp) - trace strokeDashoffset decreases 0.93->0 continuously, is-broken/gap/flag only inside the ~24-36% window, nodes 1..5 advance one at a time. Global - overflowX 0 and no off-viewport SVG text on a full-page sweep at 1366x768/1280x800/1024x768 plus spot checks at 1600/1440/834/390; zero console and page errors everywhere; 05 and 07 pinned reading keeps the active body inside .cx-copywin (only a transient 4px top overshoot on the final state at 1024x768, and apparent overshoots vanish once the 0.5s tracking animation settles - wait >=1.2s after scrolling before measuring). Remaining open items are the two 960-1200px band issues above. Out of scope pre-existing (unchanged): .cx-flow-stage taller than a 900px viewport, section 03 seismic rows on short viewports, section 02 last element row at 390px.
rca_of_the_issue: Both open defects share one root cause: the responsive treatment of sections 06/08/12 is gated on a single max-width:1200px media query. (a) Layout: the stacked mobile convergence diagram (.cx-final-dwg--m, 80% width, 440x252 viewBox) becomes 469-541px tall at 1024-1180px while .cx-final is only 240vh, so the copy block starts above the diagram bottom and the SVG labels land on the copy. (b) Typography: SVG font-size is expressed in viewBox user units, so the raised mobile sizes (13px/18px) are multiplied by the viewBox-to-pixel scale (~1.4-1.7 at 1024-1180, ~1.3 at 834), producing 24-30px annotations and re-introducing the AIR/VAPOUR* and CRITICAL JUNCTIONS/THERMAL CONTINUITY collisions. Reproduce: load /construction.html at 1024x768 (or 1180x900), scroll to 30% of .cx-final for (a) and to the top of .cx-det-fig for (b).
